import pytest

# Function under test
def lru_cache(capacity: int):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    cache = OrderedDict()

    def get(key):
        if key in cache:
            cache.move_to_end(key)
            return cache[key]
        return -1

    def put(key, value):
        if key in cache:
            cache.move_to_end(key)
        cache[key] = value
        if len(cache) > capacity:
            cache.popitem(last=False)

    return get, put


class TestLRUCache:
    """Happy Path Tests"""

    def test_basic_put_and_get(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 10)
        assert get(1) == 10

    def test_update_existing_key(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 10)
        put(1, 20)
        assert get(1) == 20

    def test_eviction_when_capacity_exceeded(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 10)
        put(2, 20)
        put(3, 30)  # evicts key 1
        assert get(1) == -1
        assert get(2) == 20
        assert get(3) == 30

    def test_get_updates_recency(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 10)
        put(2, 20)
        get(1)      # key 1 becomes most-recently used
        put(3, 30)  # should evict key 2, not key 1
        assert get(1) == 10
        assert get(2) == -1
        assert get(3) == 30

    def test_put_existing_key_updates_recency(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 10)
        put(2, 20)
        put(1, 100)  # updating key 1 makes it most-recently used
        put(3, 30)   # should evict key 2
        assert get(1) == 100
        assert get(2) == -1
        assert get(3) == 30

    """Edge Case Tests"""

    def test_capacity_one(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(1)
        put(1, 10)
        put(2, 20)  # evicts 1 immediately
        assert get(1) == -1
        assert get(2) == 20

    def test_capacity_zero(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(0)
        put(1, 10)
        put(2, 20)
        assert get(1) == -1
        assert get(2) == -1

    def test_negative_capacity(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(-1)
        put(1, 10)
        assert get(1) == -1

    def test_get_nonexistent_key(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        assert get(999) == -1

    def test_overwrite_does_not_increase_size(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(1, 10)
        put(1, 20)  # overwrite; cache size should still be 1
        put(2, 30)
        put(3, 40)  # should evict key 1 (now the LRU)
        assert get(1) == -1
        assert get(2) == 30
        assert get(3) == 40

    def test_none_key_and_value(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        put(None, "null")
        assert get(None) == "null"
        put("key", None)
        assert get("key") is None

    def test_various_hashable_key_types(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(3)
        put("string", 1)
        put((1, 2), 2)   # tuple
        put(3.14, 3)     # float
        put(True, 4)     # bool
        assert get("string") == 1
        assert get((1, 2)) == 2
        assert get(3.14) == 3
        assert get(True) == 4

    def test_multiple_evictions(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        for i in range(1, 6):
            put(i, i * 10)
        # Only the last two items should remain
        assert get(1) == -1
        assert get(2) == -1
        assert get(3) == -1
        assert get(4) == 40
        assert get(5) == 50

    def test_independent_caches(self):
        get_a, put_a = lru_cache(2)
        get_b, put_b = lru_cache(2)
        put_a(1, "a")
        put_b(1, "b")
        assert get_a(1) == "a"
        assert get_b(1) == "b"

    """Error Case Tests"""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_capacity", ["2", None, [2]])
    def test_invalid_capacity_type(self, bad_capacity):
        get, put = lru_cache(bad_capacity)
        # TypeError manifests only when the internal comparison runs
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            put(1, 10)

    def test_put_missing_arguments(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            put(1)

    def test_put_too_many_arguments(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            put(1, 2, 3)

    def test_get_missing_arguments(self):
        get, put = lru_cache(2)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            get()
